says: In next/, a new layer-rules.json row under next/packages/libfabrika/src with no `imports` list lets its files import every lower part, and no check refuses such a row; the old exam refused a library row its table did not map.
proof: With a copy of layer-rules.json that adds {"name":"next-plant","paths":["next/packages/libfabrika/src/plant"]} after next-apps, and a file src/plant/x.ts importing ../ledger/Ledger.ts, `code-graph . --layers --layer-rules <copy>` printed "allowlist: OK" and exited 0.
cost: A row added without an imports list silently widens what a part may import, caught only if the owner's read of the exam path notices it.
